name: tinkster
description: Short, simple, offline mini-games for when you're stuck waiting. No accounts, no tracking.

scripts.test:visual: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v tinkster-node-modules:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble bash -lc 'npm ci && npx playwright test --project=visual'
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v tinkster-node-modules:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble bash -lc 'npm ci && npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots'
